en_title: Robert Pattinson Says Steven Soderbergh Is 'Completely Selfless' for Taking Over on The Batman Part 2
cn_title: 《新蝙蝠侠》帕丁森赞索德伯格「完全无私」
subtitle: 为朋友接棒
opus_summary: 罗伯特·帕丁森称赞索德伯格协助拍完《新蝙蝠侠2》的举动完全无私。里维斯因私事暂离，后期仍由他负责。影片已恢复拍摄，帕丁森预计下周回到片场继续出演蝙蝠侠。

paragraphs.en: The Batman Part 2 star Robert Pattinson has called Steven Soderbergh stepping in to help finish the film a "selfless" act.
paragraphs.cn: 《新蝙蝠侠2》主演罗伯特·帕丁森称，史蒂文·索德伯格出手协助完成影片拍摄，是「无私」之举。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, it was revealed that Steven Soderbergh would be stepping in to help finish The Batman Part 2 . Director Matt Reeves ultimately had to step away from the film during its final weeks of production for a personal matter, and Soderbergh offered to help get principal photography across the finish line. He will then pass the baton back to Reeves, who will handle the post-production process.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，有消息透露，史蒂文·索德伯格将出手协助完成《新蝙蝠侠2》的拍摄。导演马特·里维斯因私事，不得不在拍摄的最后几周暂时离开剧组，索德伯格便主动提出帮忙完成主体拍摄。随后，他会将影片交回里维斯，由后者负责后期制作。

paragraphs.en: It's a unique situation, but one that Soderbergh is doing to help Reeves deliver on his vision. It's not a case of a studio getting rid of one guy to bring in a yes-man to carry out their wishes; it's a friend helping out a pal during a tough time.
paragraphs.cn: 这种情况很特殊，但索德伯格此举是为了帮助里维斯实现他的创作构想。这并非片方赶走一个人，再找来一个唯命是从的人执行片方的意愿，而是朋友在对方遇到困难时伸出援手。

paragraphs.en: When speaking with GamesRadar , Pattinson addressed the situation and spoke highly of Soderbergh for helping out on The Batman Part 2.
paragraphs.cn: 帕丁森在接受GamesRadar采访时谈到了此事，对索德伯格出手协助拍摄《新蝙蝠侠2》给予了高度评价。

paragraphs.en: “I am so happy he’s come on to help Matt,” Pattinson said of Soderbergh. “It’s incredibly generous of him – and he’s doing it in the loveliest way. It’s completely selfless. I think Matt had put so much work into the script, and we’re almost done. So for someone to come in and say, ‘I just want to help Matt do it; I want to do it in conjunction with him and just get it to the edit.’ And to have someone who’s as talented as Steven doing it is great.”
paragraphs.cn: 谈到索德伯格，帕丁森说：「他能来帮助马特，我真的很高兴。他实在太慷慨了，而且帮忙的方式也特别贴心，完全是无私的。我觉得马特在剧本上投入了太多心血，而我们也快拍完了。能有人在这个时候过来说：『我只是想帮马特完成这部电影；我想和他一起合作，把影片拍完，送进剪辑阶段。』而且来帮忙的人又像史蒂文这样才华出众，真是太好了。」

paragraphs.en: Pattinson also noted that filming has resumed, and he is expected to return to set as Bruce Wayne/Batman next week. The film's story remains tightly under wraps, as we don't even know who the villains are. Sebastian Stan is expected to play one of the antagonists and has long been rumored for Harvey Dent, but his shaved head has made fans wonder if that's accurate. Scarlett Johansson is also confirmed to have a large role, but it's unclear who she will play or what side of the moral spectrum she will be on.
paragraphs.cn: 帕丁森还提到，影片已经恢复拍摄，他预计下周回到片场，继续饰演布鲁斯·韦恩／蝙蝠侠。影片剧情仍严格保密，我们甚至还不知道反派是谁。塞巴斯蒂安·斯坦预计将饰演其中一名反派，长期以来一直有传闻称他的角色是哈维·登特，但他剃光头的造型让影迷开始怀疑这一传闻是否准确。斯嘉丽·约翰逊也已确认将出演重要角色，但她会饰演谁、角色是正是邪，目前都不清楚。

paragraphs.en: The Batman Part 2 is slated to hit theaters on February 18, 2026.
